items.title: Global oil stocks tumble as crude prices retreat after U.S. halts Iran strikes
items.summary: Investing.com -- Shares in oil and gas producers across the U.S. and Europe fell sharply after the U.S. military halted two weeks of strikes on Iran, with Tehran signaling it would suspend its own attacks as long as the pause holds, easing fears of a broader Middle East escalation and dragging crude prices lower.
